text: Agile methodology is a modern way of managing projects, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything at once, teams work in short cycles called sprints, usually lasting two to four weeks. Before each sprint, the team chooses tasks from a priority list called the backlog. These tasks are often written as user stories, which describe what a user needs from the product. Every day, team members hold short meetings called standups to share progress and discuss problems. This iterative development approach allows teams to improve the product step by step, respond quickly to changes, and deliver value to customers sooner.
